RECOMMENDED STARTING COURSE

Web Security Foundations

Beginners, students, and developers who want to understand web security before studying individual vulnerabilities.

Before you start

  • Comfort using a web browser and navigating websites.
  • No previous security-testing experience required. Basic HTML is helpful, not required.

Courses and their module order

Web Security Foundations

4 lessons

Start with how web applications work, then learn how identity, sessions, and access decisions keep users and data safe.

  1. 1

    Understand the web

    You can trace a request and identify the boundary where a security decision belongs.

    • Web Application Security Fundamentals →
    • HTTP Requests & Responses →
  2. 2

    Protect identity & access

    You can distinguish a login problem from an authorization problem and explain the relevant defenses.

    • Authentication & Session Security →
    • Access Control & Authorization →
